Warehouse Operations Overview
The distribution network operates three shifts across each facility: morning (6am-2pm), afternoon
(2pm-10pm), and overnight (10pm-6am). Shift supervisors must confirm staffing levels two hours
before each shift change and report any coverage gap to the regional operations manager
immediately.
Warehouse staff scheduling changes require at least 5 days advance notice to the shift supervisor,
except in documented emergencies. Equipment safety inspections are conducted daily at the start
of the morning shift. Any safety incident must be reported within one hour using the incident
reporting system, independent of the company's general code of conduct policy maintained by HR.
